acceptedConstraints: Keep historical, estimate and unknown distinguishable. Never imply current remaining capacity from historical usage or strategy window.
Do not invent a friendly model label or infer hard capacity. Preserve complete identifiers and source/method/timestamps in an accessible disclosure.
Preserve official Thread, existing plugin entry, private read controller, explicit refresh and lazy detail ownership. No new measurement call, dependency, authority or background read.

recommendedHierarchy.content: Context observation title, last observed use and observation time. For known fixture data a possible presentation is “2,048 tokens · estimate” plus localized observation time; zero remains a valid estimate.
One plain qualification: “Historical estimate. Current use and remaining space are unknown.” Unknown and empty states retain their own truthful copy rather than displaying a numeric zero.

Existing explicit refresh action and the source/measurement disclosure. Place strategy-window estimate, model hard limit unknown, compression not observed, exact model identity, source and UTC times in the relevant disclosure instead of repeating multiple explanatory paragraphs before the main value.
Recorded material references and explicitly requested detail remain separate disclosures/actions; no automatic detail fetch. Long identifiers wrap inside the disclosure and remain keyboard reachable.

tradeoff: Moving secondary diagnostics down improves the narrow-screen first view, while the existing disclosure keeps precise evidence reachable. Do not remove uncertainty labels from the primary number or conceal a genuine current read error.
acceptanceOnExistingPlan: Show normal short-identifier data and the retained extreme long-identifier case in both themes at narrow and desktop sizes. The normal view should put useful value/time/qualification above the fold.
Preserve the exact underlying identity/source values, zero/unknown/empty distinctions, error and pending states, explicit refresh and one lazy detail read.
Enter/Tab/Escape and return-focus behavior remain intact; a long disclosure must be reachable by keyboard and scroll without horizontal overflow.
Keep existing synthetic/history-only and NOT_COVERED claims explicit. New screenshots cannot establish real producer/current-window/Arc combination behavior.
notAChangeNow: Current8819/a630 delivery remains approved within its original scope. Owner and D01 choose the next lawful implementation segment and exact scope; this file does not grant runtime, expand a claim or authorize copying old App blobs.
cleanCode: Prefer restructuring the existing dialog and native disclosure. Extract a display helper only if it hides a coherent measurement/time-formatting responsibility; do not introduce a second controller or a large configurable dashboard schema.
